content.text: {"headline":"Approve P3: outage IVR message, chat deflection, delayed payments breaks and overtime for 30 payments agents, 13:00-15:00 (₹9,768). Best available plan, though it falls just short of the 80% target.","why":"The card authorisation gateway outage (P1 ticket INC-20261001-6607) is driving the surge, led by card_declined calls at 2.22x normal. No plan reaches 80% over the 13:00-15:00 window, and P3 comes closest. It predicts 75.5% service level (payments 68.7%, general 87.9%) and 7.4% abandons, against 38.7% and 23.7% if we do nothing. The outage message and chat deflection cut the avoidable calls, and the overtime covers the rest. Rest of day is predicted at 89.9%. There are no policy breaches and no escalation is flagged.","trade_offs":["Cost: P3 costs ₹9,768 vs ₹588 for P2 (outage response only). P2 reaches only 51.9% with 13.3% abandons.","R1 (₹11,976) and R2 (₹12,468) use more overtime but cost more and do slightly worse (74.8% and 73.8%), though they give general a bit more headroom (89.8% and 89.6%).","P4 (₹7,020) relies on staffing and callback without the outage message and only reaches 54.9%.","The no-cost plan P1 makes things worse (29.8%), because the callback adds load and general drops to 62.9%.","Risk to the other queue is low: general improves from 69.9% with no action to 87.9% under P3."],"watch":"Payments is still below target at 68.7%. Check overtime uptake: the plan depends on 30 agents accepting. Also watch whether card_declined volume falls once the gateway finishes failing over to its backup site. If the outage runs past 15:00, the window will need extending."}
